$comment: The icons contract. This file is data, not a JSON Schema meta-schema: it states the shape the consumer relies on and the placeholder vocabulary rules, so a mapping entry and a template can be checked against a written contract instead of against a renderer's behaviour. `schema_major` is the consumer-compatibility version (spine AD-12) and moves independently of the repo tag; raising it requires a MAJOR tag.

paths.note: Both roots are repo-local and relative to this repository's root. This file names no deployment path and no consumer destination (spine AD-2/AD-6).

shape.description: A mapping file is a YAML document whose TOP-LEVEL KEYS are icon groups. A group is a logical name, not necessarily a directory: `battery`, `network` and `wifi-*` all live under `status-bar/`, addressed by their variant `template` paths. The only directory knob is the group's optional `template_dir`. `defaults.yaml` is the exception: its top-level key is `defaults`, the group-independent COLOR_* vocabulary, not a group.

mapping_file.root: mapping of group name -> group entry
mapping_file.consumer: a consumer loads ONE mapping file per render. `icons.yaml` is the manifest the current pipeline renders; the per-concern files (battery.yaml, network.yaml, power-menu.yaml, wallpaper-selector.yaml, wlogout.yaml, email-client.yaml) and defaults.yaml ship in the same class and are deployed alongside it.

group_entry.id: string — the group name; the key itself, unique within its mapping file
group_entry.template_dir: string — OPTIONAL directory under `templates_root` that variant templates are joined under; defaults to "." (the templates root itself). Must stay inside `templates_root`
group_entry.color_mappings: object — OPTIONAL COLOR_NAME -> value (a literal color, or a scheme role the consumer resolves before rendering)
group_entry.variants: array — REQUIRED, at least one; see variant_entry
group_entry.consumer_metadata: `bar_mappings`, `output_dir` and `unsafe` are passed through by the consumer (AGS state -> variant tables, per-group output directory, unsafe-render flag). This repository ships them as data and `make validate-icons` does not interpret them.

variant_entry.name: string — REQUIRED, unique within the group; the selector a consumer asks for
variant_entry.template: string — REQUIRED path to the SVG RELATIVE TO THE GROUP'S TEMPLATE ROOT (`templates_root/<template_dir>`, where `template_dir` defaults to "."): forward slashes, no leading `/`, no `..`. The consumer joins it under that root — not under the mapping file's directory
variant_entry.output: string — REQUIRED; the rendered file name the consumer writes. A bare file name: no path separators, no `..`, no placeholder
variant_entry.color_mappings: object — OPTIONAL per-variant override, highest priority in the merge

placeholder_vocabulary.description: Placeholders are the only variable part of a template. The vocabulary is a contract: renaming a token breaks every consumer that supplies it, so a rename is a MAJOR change even though no file moved.
placeholder_vocabulary.syntax: {{COLOR_NAME}} — exactly two opening braces, the name, two closing braces, no whitespace inside, nothing else on the token
rules: Every token used by any .svg under a group's template directory MUST be declared in that group's `color_mappings` (or a variant override), or in `icons/mappings/defaults.yaml` (the group-independent vocabulary).
Declaring a token no SVG uses is allowed (forward compatibility); `make validate-icons` reports it, it does not fail the tag.
No defaults, filters, conditionals or nesting inside a token: `{{COLOR_BG|#000}}`, `{{ COLOR_BG }}` and `{{{{...}}}}` are invalid.

A token is substituted by the CONSUMER at render time. No rendered SVG, no generated icon index and no palette state is ever committed here (spine AD-11), so a preview of this corpus lives in the consumer, not in this repository.
`output` values and mapping keys may not contain `{{`: a placeholder in a destination is not renderable by any consumer.

validation.make validate: The envelope: valid JSON, integer `schema_major`, and the `shape` / `placeholder_vocabulary` sections present (scripts/validate-catalog.py).
make validate-icons: every `template:` in every mapping file resolves to a real file under `icons/templates/<template_dir>/`
every `{{COLOR_*}}` token used by a template is declared in `defaults.yaml` or that group's / variant's `color_mappings`
every SVG under `icons/templates/` parses as XML
every `variant.name` is unique within its group
every `output` is a bare file name and every `template` stays inside the templates root
reported_not_failed: a token declared for a group but unused by its templates (forward compatibility)
a group name defined by more than one mapping file — the consumer loads one file, so the copies can disagree
validation.make validate-content: The content class: `content/wallpapers/wallpapers.tar.gz` holds a top-level `default.png`, every `*.theme` is non-empty, and no archive member escapes the archive root.
validation.new_work: No schema file existed anywhere in the dotfiles corpus before this repository. The shape above is written from what the consumer's loader already expects (icon_templates_renderer `YamlIconConfigLoader` + `PathResolutionService`), and since v0.2.0 it is enforced against the shipped corpus by `make validate-icons`, not only stated.
